pages.title: Lawgiver's Codex
pages.text: Blank, until you write. Then the place you stand in obeys what you wrote.

Open it to rewrite the laws of the place you stand in: gravity, time and weather, which creatures may appear and how strong they are. Look at a creature while opening it to rewrite that creature too. "Restore" puts the natural laws back.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnipotence Core.
